Conditions the schools list

  • Published receiving-school award; individual credit, duplicate learning, catalog eligibility, and the current provider recommendation version require Liberty evaluation. No student award is asserted.

A listing here means the school’s published guidance accepts this course for that requirement in that plan. Your school still evaluates your official records, completion dates and eligibility. It does not mean the course counts at other schools or in other programs, and a provider’s credit recommendation is not itself a school award.
